description: List floorplans (PDF page-level floors or site-level sheets). Filter by building_id for a building's floors, or by site_id for site-level plans (campus maps, outdoor layouts). Each floorplan belongs to exactly one of building OR site. A multi-page PDF produces multiple floorplans sharing the same pdf_storage_path.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

site_id.description: Filter by site ID (site-scoped floorplans only)

name: list_floorplans
title: List floorplans
